envelope.description: Store: three new sub-DBs and the V4->V5 migration step

body.title: Store: three new sub-DBs and the V4->V5 migration step
body.summary: In src/db/graph/store.ts open unresolved_by_target (dupsort, awaited id -> pending row id), export_names (dupsort, (file u64, exported name) -> target id) and index_state (repoId -> IndexStateRow) beside unresolved_by_file; IndexStateRow encode/decode in src/db/graph/codec.ts; SCHEMA_VERSION 4 -> 5 and MIGRATION_V4_TO_V5 in src/db/graph/migrations.ts, which opens the three sub-DBs and writes an IndexStateRow per workspace repository with fullIndexFinished false and pending counts recounted from the existing rows. removeRepo (src/db/repos.ts:177) deletes the repository's index_state row with its registry row. Anchors: unresolvedByFile is opened at src/db/graph/store.ts:558 (open_ at :532-536 opens dupsort sub-DBs); none of unresolved_by_target, export_names or index_state exists in src today. The migration runner runs each step and writes the new version in one transaction (src/db/graph/migrations.ts:442-447, store.root.transaction), and src/db/graph/__tests__/migrations.test.ts already proves a throwing step leaves the previous version (the test 'runMigrations leaves intermediate version on disk after a per-step crash', :151-176: the throwing step at :156 rejects at :159 and the stored version stays 2 at :165); row codecs live in src/db/graph/codec.ts (e.g. decodeEdgeProps at :209). removeRepo (src/db/repos.ts:177) removes the registry row inside withWriteTxn (:196-199); the index_state delete goes in that same callback.
acceptanceChecks: A V4 store opened by the new code is at version 5 with the three sub-DBs and one IndexStateRow per workspace repository, fullIndexFinished false, pending counts equal to a recount of the existing rows
A migration whose run throws leaves the stored version at 4 and the store unchanged
V1->V2, V2->V3 and V3->V4 steps are untouched (existing migration tests pass)
repo.remove leaves no index_state row for the removed repository

tests.name: src/db/graph/__tests__/migration-v4-to-v5.test.ts: V4 store migrates to 5 with three sub-DBs and one IndexStateRow per repository; a throwing step leaves version 4
src/db/__tests__/repos-lmdb.test.ts: repo.remove deletes the index_state row
